description:
Join to apply for the Project Manager role at Fever

Join to apply for the Project Manager role at Fever

Hey there!
We’re Fever, the world’s leading tech platform for culture and live entertainment,
Our mission? To democratize access to culture and entertainment. With our proprietary cutting-edge technology and data-driven approach, we’re revolutionizing the way people engage with live entertainment.
Every month, our platform inspires over 300 million people in +40 countries (and counting) to discover unforgettable experiences while also empowering event creators with our data and technology, helping them scale, innovate, and enhance their events to reach new audiences.
Our results? We’ve teamed up with major industry leaders like Netflix, F.C. Barcelona, and Primavera Sound, presented international award-winning experiences, and are backed by several leading global investors! Impressive, right?
To achieve our mission, we are looking for bar-raisers with a hands-on mindset who are eager to help shape the future of entertainment!
Ready to be part of the experience?
Now, let’s discuss this role and what you will do to help achieve Fever’s mission.
As part of the Fever Originals team , you will use data and insights to create one-of-a-kind events and experiences that allow people to have unforgettable moments.
Who You'll Work With
You will join our Sao Paulo office to work in teams and directly interact with our partners, providers, and venues.
In this role you will help Fever grow its pipeline of original events. To do so, you will interact with all departments of Fever, from Marketing to Operations.
The team you’re about to join consists of people that are motivated, young, and fun. On top of having multicultural backgrounds, people in the team are all top profiles: McKinsey, Amazon, Google, KKR, Cirque du Soleil, PSG, and Roland Garros.
What you'll do
As a Project Manager, you will work with your team lead to develop, launch and manage your events, from A to Z. Together with the other departments, you will define the way to scale a wide range of events across Brazil.
You will be responsible for owning the strategic planning, execution, and reporting for our key strategic experience.
When you join Fever, you are joining a company that will invest in your professional development. You will receive training and coaching on how to:

  • Provide a detailed analysis of business opportunities and inefficiencies; proposing changes to operational processes; driving a high standard in customer satisfaction; ensuring high-quality experiences are delivered
  • Manage events from conception to delivery, working with existing partners and developing new relationships
  • Manage, report on, and grow revenue from our events.
  • Help to scale the events experience across other cities through developing and sharing best practices.
  • Coordinate with different internal teams at Fever.
  • Work with the Fever marketing team to make sure events make an impact: both in terms of ticket sales and coverage
  • Foster and grow the Fever Partner Network: including venues and event organizers
  • Communicate product needs (Fever usability) and process needs to HQ, work with product/engineering to deliver on them
  • Represent Fever at local events and with local PR
Employees are expected to be in the office Monday to Thursday with possibility to work from home on Fridays
Preferred Qualifications
  • 4+ years in a project management role or consulting background. This is not a position for an events background
  • Fluent English and Native-level Portuguese
  • You'll be solution-focused, identifying problem areas and then creating plans to find resolutions
  • You'll have strong communication skills and a proven track record of building positive working relationships
  • Highly organized and efficient
  • High analytical mindset
  • Ability to think strategically when faced with an events partnership brief or with our proprietary data on what events work
  • Able to handle large amounts of work and parallel work-streams
  • Collaborative and willing to get hands dirty and work on all required events tasks
  • Knowledge of promotional tools such as Facebook and Instagram is a plus
  • Strong academic background is a plus
You can expect to join a group of diverse, hardworking team players, where a cultural fit is someone willing to stay humble and learn and can work nimbly. We welcome applications with unusual backgrounds with the expectation that the applicant will have acquired hard or soft skills and maturity throughout their experiences.
What You'll Get
  • Attractive compensation package and the potential to earn a significant bonus for top performance
  • Opportunity to have a real impact in a high-growth global category leader
  • 40% discount on all Fever events and experiences
  • Work in the heart of the city, with possible travel across our markets
  • Health Insurance
  • Meal tickets & transportation pass
  • English lessons
  • Responsibility from day one and professional and personal growth
  • Great work environment with a young, international team of talented people to work with
Our hiring process
  • A 30 min video call with one of our Talent Acquisition Managers, to better understand your career plan, assess cultural fit and answer any questions you may have
  • A 60 min online test with three topics: logic, analytics and written understanding
  • A 30 min call with the hiring manager
  • A 45 min video call with your future manager, including questions about your profile and a business case presentation (to be prepared in advance)
On average our process lasts 20 working days and offers usually follow within a week.

Ensino Superior Completo em Medicina/ Residência Médica ou Título de Especialista em Angiologia/ Registro Ativo no Conselho da Classe/ Experiência comprovada como Médico Angiologista.

Vagas para as regiões:

ASPDM - Associação Paulista para o Desenvolvimento da Medicina é uma Associação civil sem fins lucrativos, de natureza filantrópica, reconhecida de utilidade pública federal, estadual e no município de sua sede, respectivamente pelos decretos nos. 57.925, de 04/03/1966, 40.103 de 17/05/1962 e 8.911, de 30/07/1970.

A Instituição atua nos âmbitos federal, estadual e municipal, em harmonia com suas políticas de saúde e de educação, e também como organização social habilitada em vários estados, na gerência de serviços e organizações de saúde, por meio de convênios e contratos de gestão.

title: Financial Crime Risk Specialist
description:
Nubank was founded in 2013 to free people from a bureaucratic, slow, and inefficient financial system. Since then, the company has been redefining people's relationships with money across Latin America through innovative technology and outstanding customer service. With operations in Brazil, Mexico, and Colombia, Nubank is one of the world’s largest digital banking platforms and technology-leading companies.
Today, Nubank is a global company with offices in São Paulo (Brazil), Mexico City (Mexico), Bogotá (Colombia), Durham (United States), and Berlin (Germany). It was founded in 2013 in Sao Paulo by Colombian David Vélez, and cofounded by Brazilian Cristina Junqueira and American Edward Wible. For more information, visit .
About the role

We are looking for an experienced and analytical Fraud Prevention Specialist to join our Fraud Oversight team, serving as the second line of defense within Nubank’s risk management structure.
If you have solid experience in fraud prevention and risk management, love to challenge the status quo, and strive for continuous improvement in risk mitigation practices, Nubank is looking for someone like you!
We are a team that constantly pushes ourselves to go beyond regulatory requirements, seeking the best market practices in an efficient and effective way, so the purple revolution can continue to grow healthily and sustainably. Your mission will be to spread risk management practices to support the Fraud (1st line) and Product teams in fraud mitigation through targeted friction, establishing risk governance as a key ally in the fight against fraud.
You will play a key role in evaluating the maturity of our products in terms of fraud prevention, analyzing associated risks, and maintaining our fraud risk and control matrix.As a Fraud Prevention Specialist in the second line, you will be responsible for:

  • Conducting Product Maturity Assessments: Perform in-depth analyses to evaluate the robustness of fraud prevention, monitoring, and alert mechanisms implemented by product teams, ensuring compliance with prevention requirements and identifying opportunities for improvement.
  • Managing the Fraud Risk and Control Matrix (RCM): Maintain, review, and update the fraud RCM to ensure alignment with Nubank’s risk management framework and proper implementation.
  • Defining and Monitoring KRIs: Collaborate in defining and tracking Key Risk Indicators (KRIs) related to fraud risks.
  • Analyzing Risks and Promoting Awareness: Analyze risks identified in post-mortem reviews and promote a culture of fraud prevention awareness across Nubank.
  • Conducting Risk Assessments: Carry out risk assessments in Fraud and Product BUs to identify risks, test the effectiveness of existing controls, and support the definition of response strategies.
  • Ensuring Methodological Alignment: Ensure that risk management methodologies are aligned with the needs of the Fraud area. Additionally, the role involves ensuring the Fraud BU operates within Nubank's risk appetite through monitoring and support.
  • Collaborating Strategically: Work closely with the Fraud BU (1st line), Product teams, and other areas, aligning priorities, sharing data-driven analyses, and facilitating communication to achieve common goals.
  • Participate in fraud risk forums and committees with senior leadership at Nubank to discuss fraud risks.
To join our team, you must have:
  • Proven experience in fraud prevention and risk management, preferably in the financial, payments, or fintech sector.
  • Deep knowledge of different fraud typologies (e.g., Identity Fraud, Mule Accounts, Card Fraud, Boleto/TED Fraud).
  • Hands-on experience with risk assessment methodologies (e.g.COSO) and in developing/maintaining Risk and Control Matrices (RCM).
  • Strong analytical skills, with the ability to interpret data, evaluate processes, identify vulnerabilities, and propose effective solutions.
  • Experience in conducting risk assessments and control testing..
  • Excellent communication skills (verbal and written) and ability to collaborate effectively with different stakeholders at various levels.
  • Ability to work independently, manage multiple tasks, and meet deadlines.
  • Proficiency in Portuguese and English (advanced level required for reading documents, communication, and attending meetings), and fluency in Spanish is a plus.
  • Familiarity with data analysis tools and fraud prevention/risk management systems.

Tätigkeitsprofil:

Das Colégio Visconde de Porto Seguro ist eine deutsche Auslandsschule, deren Abschlüsse von der KMK in Deutschland anerkannt werden. Die Schule wird von der Bundesrepublik Deutschland als Begegnungsschule gefördert und ist von der Ständigen Konferenz der Kultusminister (KMK) zur Abhaltung von Prüfungen der allgemeinen deutschen Hochschulreife (Abitur) ermächtigt. Mit zwei aufeinander abgestimmten Bildungsplänen sind sowohl deutsche als auch brasilianische Abschlüsse anerkannt und möglich.

Unsere freundlichen und sehr motivierten Schülerinnen und Schüler lernen in zwei Kulturkreisen, bereits vom Kindergarten an. So erwerben sie erweiterte Kenntnisse über Werte, Normen, Geschichte und Mentalität eines anderen Landes.

Es wird eine Stelle in Vollzeit angeboten. Das Deputat umfasst 26 Stunden pro Unterrichtswoche. Neben dem Unterricht ist die Bereitschaft zur Mitarbeit in schulischen Gremien sowie Engagement bei außerunterrichtlichen Veranstaltungen erwünscht.

Die Tätigkeit umfasst:

  • Klassenleitung
  • Fachunterricht in den Klassenstufen 5-12
  • Mitarbeit in der Unterrichts- und Schulentwicklung

Anforderungsprofil:

Gesucht werden engagierte Lehrkräfte, die Freude am pädagogischen Umgang mit Kindern haben und über Sozialkompetenz, selbstständige Arbeitsweise und freundliches Auftreten verfügen. Erforderlich sind hohe Flexibilität, Aufgeschlossenheit, Motivation sowie Teamfähigkeit und Interesse am kulturellen Umfeld (Brasilien/Südamerika). Die Beherrschung der Landessprache (Portugiesisch) ist keine Einstellungsvoraussetzung, wird aber während des Arbeitsverhältnisses begrüßt und gefördert.

  • Lehrbefähigung in Fach Kunst und idealerweise einem abiturrelevanten Zweitfach (z.B. Deutsch, Englisch, Mathematik, Geschichte, Philosophie, Biologie, Chemie, Physik)
  • Bewerber(innen) müssen über das 1. und 2. Staatsexamen (Lehramt) oder einen vergleichbaren Abschluss verfügen
  • Erfahrung im Umgang mit digitalen Medien als Unterrichtswerkzeug
  • Überdurchschnittliche Einsatzbereitschaft, Neugier und Arbeitsfreude
  • Teamfähigkeit, Flexibilität, Belastbarkeit
  • Idealerweise Unterrichts- und Projekterfahrung in der gymnasialen Oberstufe

Sie erwartet ein hochinteressantes Arbeitsumfeld in einem motivierten, netten Team.

Die Vergütung richtet sich nach der gültigen Gehaltsrichtlinie der Schule und liegt im Landesvergleich überdurchschnittlich. Weitere Leistungen wie Krankenversicherung, Lebensversicherung und Mietzuschuss sind enthalten. Bei Zuzug aus dem Ausland erhalten Sie eine Umzugspauschale sowie eine Flugkostenpauschale.

description:
Figma is growing our team of passionate people on a mission to make design accessible to all. Born on the Web , Figma helps entire product teams brainstorm , design and build better products — from start to finish. Whether it’s consolidating tools, simplifying workflows, or collaborating across teams and time zones, Figma makes the design process faster, more efficient, and fun while keeping everyone on the same page. From great products to long-lasting companies, we believe that nothing great is made alone—comemake with us!

Figma is looking for a Manager, Commercial Sales to join our dynamic team of creatives, engineers, marketing wizards, and brilliant business folks. You aren’t the typical sales leader, and we aren’t the typical design tool company. At Figma we think outside the box, lift constraints that block our imagination everyday and we expect you to do the same. With this role you’ll get in at the ground floor in a fast growing sales org. You’ll consult with our existing customer base and potential customers in driving meaningful relationships that add value to the customer experience and revenue to our bottom line.

Figma is growing and moving fast. Our next team member will have an agile, dynamic mindset, be comfortable embracing change, a true team-player, and love working with our growing footprint of Fortune 1000 customers. You won’t be alone! Figma has an incredible team and you’ll work closely with other groups including Support, Design, Engineering, Product Marketing, Customer Success, and Community. As Manager, Commercial Sales, you will lead a team of Account Executives responsible for continuing the growth of our SMB and MId-Market products. You will report directly to our Senior Director, Sales LATAM.

What you’ll do at Figma:

  • Lead a team of motivated and diverse individuals to foster an environment of success
  • Participate in customer and prospect meetings
  • Assist in continual training and development, including mentorship, hiring and career growth
  • Help shape and further develop sales processes and initiatives
  • Interview, hire and train new team members as we scale the business and company
  • Deliver weekly forecast meetings and advise Account Executives on strategies to help exceed their goal

We'd love to hear from you if you have:

  • 5+ years of sales experience (preferably within SaaS)
  • 1+ years of management or team lead experience
  • Understanding of our technical and competitive landscape
  • Ability to thrive in a constantly changing and evolving environment
  • Exceptional coaching, writing, discovery and presentation skills
  • Excitement for increasing customer happiness and developing lasting customer relationships
  • Proven track record of leading successful and consistent sales team
  • This role will focus on supporting customers using our product in Latin America. Written and spoken fluency in Portuguese, Spanish, and English is required
At Figma, one of our values is Grow as you go. We believe in hiring smart, curious people who are excited to learn and develop their skills. If you’re excited about this role but your past experience doesn’t align perfectly with the points outlined in the job description, we encourage you to apply anyways. You may be just the right candidate for this or other roles.

At Figma we celebrate and support our differences. We know employing a team rich in diverse thoughts, experiences, and opinions allows our employees, our product and our community to flourish. Figma is an equal opportunity workplace - we are dedicated to equal employment opportunities regardless of race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital status, disability, gender identity/expression, veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by law. We also consider qualified applicants regardless of criminal histories, consistent with legal requirements.

title: Backend Software Engineer Specialist
description:
About Digibee

Digibee is an iPaaS that scales integration workflows while reducing cost and technical debt. Rather than require specialized integration experts, Digibee lets every developer quickly build, test, deploy, govern, and monitor integrations across on-premise and cloud environments using a simple but powerful low-code interface.

Founded in São Paulo, Brazil, in 2017 and headquartered in Weston, Florida, our team is widely distributed throughout the Americas. In May of 2023, Digibee closed a Series B funding round of $60 million that is intended to drive our expansion in the United States.

About the role

We're looking for a Backend engineer to contribute disruptive ideas to our Integration Platform, making it robust and scalable. The candidate must be very rigorous in decisions and in developing clean, secure, and sustainable code.

On a typical day, you will…

  • Participate in discussions about architectural solutions and what would be the best methods to solve a given problem;
  • Conduct maintenance and development of new features from beginning to end using best programming practices;
  • Collaborate with the development team to analyze requirements and transform them into efficient solutions.

What You'll Need To Bring...

  • 2+ years of experience in software development using Java;
  • Experience using Spring or Quarkus;
  • Experience in developing distributed solutions using microservices, messaging, and streaming;
  • Unit Testing (Cucumber: BDD Testing);
  • Experience in agile models (Scrum/Kanban);
  • Experience in developing solutions using NoSQL databases (MongoDB and ElasticSearch) and Relational Databases (MySQL, PostgreSQL, and/or Oracle);
  • Experience with Git version control.

It's a plus if you have...

  • Experience in developing solutions based on Open Container, Kubernetes, and Cloud Computing;
  • Knowledge in Kotlin and Go programming languages;
  • Continuous Integration and Continuous Deployment;
  • Knowledge in Static and Dynamic Analysis of code.

Benefits & Culture

  • Remote-first with flexible working hours;
  • R$ 1.200,00/month on Caju card (for food, mobility, home office supplies, culture, health, and education);
  • Life insurance;
  • Child care assistance;
  • Gympass;
  • English course partnership for R$100 monthly.

We believe in a highly collaborative work environment that fosters constant development and knowledge sharing. We value diversity and are committed to creating a supportive, respectful community.

title: Backend Software Engineer Senior - Vaga afirmativa para mulheres
description:
Sobre nós

A ambição da Swile é criar um mundo de trabalho gratificante e transformar em prioridade a experiência do colaborador. Por isso queremos criar uma marca poderosa dentro do mundo do trabalho, no Brasil, na França e no resto do mundo.

Sobre o tempo e a posição

Para quem gosta de melhoria contínua, essa vaga é para você. Essa pessoa desenvolvedora vai auxiliar nossos desenvolvedores a melhorar nosso aplicativo atual (Swile by Vee), buscando integrar melhorar práticas, seja isso em uma linha ou na arquitetura do todo, a autonomia é a irmã da comunicação.

Ser Sr. Software Engineer na Swile é impactar positivamente a vida de nossos clientes e usuários tomando decisões com base em dados e garantindo a eficiência, estabilidade e desempenho de nossas aplicações. Ao traduzir as visões de produto para software, resolvemos problemas complexos que possibilitam uma experiência única, estável e funcional para todos.

Como engenheiros de backend, atuamos em aplicações como APIs REST, dashboards, ferramentas e serviços internos que possibilitam aos nossos clientes e usuários usar seus benefícios de forma flexível, fácil e disponível sempre que necessário.

Principais atividades no time

Engenharia de Software

- Produzir código de alta qualidade documentado, eficiente, testado e manutenível

- Assegurar e melhorar a observabilidade e monitoramento nas aplicações

- Foco em melhorar aspectos técnicos de outros membros, padrões e qualidade geral do tempo proativamente

- Aprender outras linguagens de programação se necessário

- Focar ativamente em melhorar a segurança, desempenho, estabilidade das aplicações

- Fazer (e receber) code reviews de qualidade para outros membros do time

Design e Arquitetura

- Exercer influência técnica colaborando com discussão embasadas e soluções objetivas soluções e simples

- Propor soluções de arquitetura colaborando e orientando outros membros do tempo para garantir requisitos funcionais e não funcionais.

Execução e Resultado

- Estimar e planejar prazos de entrega junto às partes interessadas e prazo de produto

- Usar soluções existentes na Swile garantindo a convergência com as plataformas globais

- Trabalhar com requisitos pouco definidos ou ambíguos para melhor definir soluções junto ao time de produto, stakeholders e outros membros do time

- Criar soluções incrementais junto ao time de produto visando a melhoria e entrega contínua das suas aplicações

- Focar em entregas testadas automatizadas e também E2E garantindo a estabilidade das aplicações

- Monitorar e agir em incidentes das aplicações em produção

Liderança

- Liderar projetos garantindo as entregas dentro das estimativas

- Evoluir membros do time tecnicamente sendo um role model

- Participar dos processos seletivos para engenheiros do mesmo level ou inferior


Requisitos mínimos:
  • Bacharel em Ciências da Computação, Engenharia, áreas relacionadas ou experiência prática similar
  • Experiência profissional com engenharia de software em Java ou Kotlin
  • Experiência em arquitetura e desenvolvimento de sistemas distribuídos
  • Experiência com tecnologias como Redis, Kafka, RabbitMQ ou similares
  • Experiência com bancos de dados relacionais e não relacionais
  • Conhecimentos com ferramentas de IA (Inteligencia Artificial)
  • Habilidade de comunicação clara e efetiva
  • Inglês Avançado/fluente
Requisitos preferenciais:
  • Mestrado ou Doutorado em Ciências da Computação ou áreas relacionadas
  • Experiência com micro serviços e arquiteturas orientadas a evento
  • Experiência com gRPC, Protocol buffer ou similares
Sobre nossos valores
  • We are team players: nós nos importamos com nossos colegas e navegamos bem entre áreas

We are energized by broadening our scope of responsibility & horizon, are curious, and love stepping outside of our comfort zone. We know that hard work beats talent - an Insider combines both. title: Senior FP&A Analyst
description:
About Digibee
Digibee is an iPaaS that scales integration workflows while reducing cost and technical debt. Rather than require specialized integration experts, Digibee lets every developer quickly build, test, deploy, govern, and monitor integrations across on-premise and cloud environments using a simple but powerful low-code interface.

Founded in São Paulo, Brazil, in 2017 and headquartered in Weston, Florida, our team is widely distributed throughout the Americas. In May of 2023, Digibee closed a Series B funding round of $60 million that is intended to drive our expansion in the United States.

About the role

We are looking for a highly skilled FP&A analyst to join our team. As a senior FP&A Analyst, you will play a critical role in managing financial planning and analysis activities, providing insights to senior management, and supporting investor relations efforts. This role requires strong analytical capabilities, financial modeling expertise, and excellent communication skills to collaborate with cross-functional teams and external stakeholders effectively.
We offer a dynamic, fast-paced environment with high-level exposure to different initiatives and projects.

On a typical day, you will…

  1. Review the monthly financial statement.
  2. Interact with the investors, being responsible for dealing with their ad hoc analysis.
  3. Conduct financial modeling and scenario analysis to evaluate strategic initiatives, investment opportunities, and business performance metrics.
  4. Develop and enhance financial measurement reporting tools.
  5. Prepare and coordinate internal and monthly reports.
  6. Prepare ad hoc analysis to support strategic decision-making.
  7. Measure and analyze the KPIs, interact with other departments to understand the current scenario, and provide this view.
  8. Prepare financial viability analysis of new investments.
  9. Lead the development of financial forecasts, budgets, and long-range plans in collaboration with functional teams.
  10. Perform variance analysis to assess financial performance against budget, forecast, and prior periods, identifying key drivers and trends for P&L, Balance Sheet, and Cash-Flow.
  11. Prepare insightful financial presentations and reports for senior management and the board of directors, highlighting key performance metrics, risks, and opportunities.
  12. Support investor relations activities, including preparation of quarterly earnings materials, investor presentations, and responding to inquiries from analysts and investors.
  13. Drive process improvements and efficiencies in financial planning and analysis processes, leveraging technology and automation tools where appropriate.
  14. Stay abreast of industry trends, competitive landscape, and regulatory developments to inform financial analysis and decision-making.

What You'll Need To Bring

  1. Bachelors in business administration, engineering, economics, accounting or similar.
  2. 5+ years of experience in financial planning and analysis, investment banking, or related roles.
  3. Knowledge of the main Financial Statements: Balance sheets, P&L and Cash Flow.
  4. Experience in Financial Modeling.
  5. Fluency in English.
  6. Advanced Excel skills.
  7. Excellent communication and presentation skills, with ability to distill complex financial concepts into clear and concise messages for diverse audiences.
  8. Proven ability to collaborate effectively with cross-functional teams and senior leadership.
  9. Detail-oriented with strong analytical and problem-solving skills.

What is nice to have

  1. Experience in SaaS Industry.
  2. VBA preferred.
  3. SQL / Python.
  4. Experience with investor relations (preferred).

Our perks and benefits

  1. We're remote first, with a flexible working schedule.
  2. Health care and Odonto Plan.
  3. R$ 1.200,00/month on Caju card (for food and meal allowance, mobility, home office supplies, culture, health, and education).
  4. Life insurance.
  5. Child care assistance.
  6. Gympass.
  7. English course: we have a partnership for group classes for R$100 monthly.

Our culture

We believe in a highly collaborative work environment in order to foster constant development and exchange between teams. We encourage learning, sharing knowledge, and using new technologies to create disruptive ideas - we want to create something great together!

At Digibee, we know it's our people who make the difference. We embrace and value diversity and are dedicated to encouraging a supportive and respectful culture in our community.

title: Senior P&E Solution Architect - SCM SAP Digital Manufacturing and SAP Integrated Business Planning
description:
Press Tab to Move to Skip to Content Link

Senior P&E Solution Architect - SCM SAP Digital Manufacturing and SAP Integrated Business Planning

At SAP, we enable you to bring out your best. Our company culture is focused on collaboration and a shared passion to help the world run better. How? We focus every day on building the foundation for tomorrow and creating a workplace that embraces differences, values flexibility, and is aligned to our purpose-driven and future-focused work. We offer a highly collaborative, caring team environment with a strong focus on learning and development, recognition for your individual contributions, and a variety of benefit options for you to choosefrom.

PURPOSE AND OBJECTIVES

SAP Digital Manufacturing is a critical mission application for our customers who produce anything from food to electronics, medical instruments or automotive parts. Our cloud service must be extremely reliable and run our customers’ shop floor operations with high performance in discrete and process manufacturing industries around the world.

SAP Integrated Business Planning (IBP) is used by more than 1000 customers globally across 24 industries as the primary supply chain planning application. Key business processes supported include Demand Planning, Supply Planning, Inventory Planning, Sales and Operations Planning, along with others.

As a Product &Engineering Solution Architect who is part of our SAP S/4HANA Product Experience - Cloud ERP Product Success team, you will transform our market and accelerate our momentum for our Cloud products.

Our team is responsible for the execution of our strategy, scope and the product experience for SCM SAP Digital Manufacturing. We focus on unlocking the right capabilities of our digital core with the needed focus to scale the business.

You will have impact and contact by bridging between our customer demand, our sales priorities and our product definition and development units. Customer adoption for SCM SAP Digital Manufacturing and SAP IBP with the rollout of new functionality will be an important part of your daily role.

DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES

You will collaborate with our customers, Implementation Partners, Field Sales, Field Services, Product Teams, Support Teams, and Development Teams across SAP to:

  • Keep track of your customer engagements and work with Customers and Services to assess and prioritize requests during the implementation of SAP Digital Manufacturing Dispatching & Execution and SAP IBP in the Americas Region, focusing on the Latin America countries.
  • Increase the success of SAP’s market-leading cloud-based manufacturing solution by providing powerful automation capabilities easy to configure, deploy and monitor across different manufacturing sites.
  • You will be working with your empowered product team to discover and deliver delighting innovations based on opportunities and problems to be solved , defined by the overall product vision and strategy. With a data-driven approach you can manage, and increment features delivered to drive adoption within the customer base.
  • Manage (understand, analyze and categorize) individual customer demand for the of SAP Digital Manufacturing Dispatching & Execution and SAP IBP in a regional setup , assuring one face to the customer from Product Success and Product Experience.
  • Work with Product and Development teams to compile SAP’s product roadmap based on customer feedback.
  • Be the voice of the product for Customers, Sales and Presales by advocating solution readiness and innovations to drive adoption of SAP Digital Manufacturing Dispatching & Execution and SAP IBP.
  • Prepare and conduct expert testing on planned and future functionality of SAP Digital Manufacturing Dispatching & Execution along with cross-functional products that will deliver the SAP Intelligent Enterprise Suite.

Your impact and support of our deliverables on the strategy of our innovations will be key via:

  • Experience in working with clients in analyzing and transferring market and client demand directly into the Product Management/Development teams (functional specification, co-innovation, etc.).
  • Excellent ability to liaise with the different internal organizations (Development, Preferred success organization, Customer first organization, Field, etc.), becoming a key counterpart for stakeholders in Product Management / Development organization.
  • Outstanding project management skills to align with the respective areas and drive projects successfully along tight deadlines.

EDUCATION AND QUALIFICATIONS/ SKILLS AND COMPETENCIES

  • Bachelor’s in Computer Science or Business Administration (Engineering) or comparable education required.
  • Relevant experience in software innovation projects, product management, support and customer facing roles (e.g. Functional consultant, solution architect, support, presales).
  • Strong experience in professional software development. Relevant working experience in the SAP environment.
  • Domain knowledge in manufacturing, planning , and/or logistics combined with strong analytical skills and technical expertise of SAP BTP based cloud solutions.
  • Domain knowledge in supply chain planning processes
  • Experience working with multiple stakeholders from cross functional teams in multiple regions/time zones.
  • Ability to distill technical information fast and prepare stakeholder specific content out of it, with the business outcome in mind and customer focus; ability to simplify complex information.
  • Experience in product definition (ideally close to a Product Owner role), alternatively: Proven track record in or on collaboration with Product Development and/or Product Management and/or Solution Management
  • Excellent communication and language skills in Portuguese, Spanish and English (spoken and written)
  • Strong interpersonal , coordination, communication and presentation skills.

Preferred skills

  • Deep understanding of the Cloud architecture and SaaS model.
  • Experience as a Subject Matter Expert in a functional area like Logistics or Manufacturing is a plus.
  • MBA or master’s degree in related field is desired.
  • Design thinking expertise welcome but not mandatory.
  • Good knowledge of Cloud principles
  • Activate Methodology is a plus
  • ERP Business Processes Knowledge
  • Experience in co-innovation processes would be a plus

The Manufacturing Dispatching & Execution team empowers manufacturers with the tools necessary to produce high-quality products consistently, comply with regulatory requirements, achieve operational transparency, ensure full traceability of materials and processes, and support sustainable practices. This holistic approach not only enhances operational efficiency but also builds customer trust and satisfaction across the board.

SAP IBP brings core supply chain planning processes into a common platform, allowing for consistency in data, collaboration between teams, and seamless integration to ERP. Benefits of IBP include: reduced inventory investments, improved customer service levels, reduced operational costs, and improved collaboration both internally and with the customer’s suppliers and customers.

Bring out your best

SAP innovations help more than four hundred thousand customers worldwide work together more efficiently and use business insight more effectively. Originally known for leadership in enterprise resource planning (ERP) software, SAP has evolved to become a market leader in end-to-end business application software and related services for database, analytics, intelligent technologies, and experience management. As a cloud company with two hundred million users and more than one hundred thousand employees worldwide, we are purpose-driven and future-focused, with a highly collaborative team ethic and commitment to personal development. Whether connecting global industries, people, or platforms, we help ensure every challenge gets the solution it deserves. At SAP,you can bring out your best.

SAP’s culture of inclusion, focus on health and well-being, and flexible working models help ensure that everyone – regardless of background – feels included and can run at their best. At SAP, we believe we are made stronger by the unique capabilities and qualities that each person brings to our company, and we invest in our employees to inspire confidence and help everyone realize their full potential. We ultimately believe in unleashing all talent and creating a better and more equitable world.

title: Marketing Director
description:
Position Summary

In the position of Marketing Director, you will lead the strategic development and execution of all brand activities (Monster Energy, Reign, and Burn) in Brazil, ensuring full alignment with global marketing standards and the U.S. model. You will manage a wide range of marketing functions—including campaigns, events, promotions, athlete management, communications, and budgets—while driving business growth through collaboration with international teams and partners. Additionally, you will integrate key brand platforms like Action and Motorsports, Gaming, and Music & Lifestyle into sales strategies to strengthen brand awareness and market presence.

Essential Job Functions

  • Coordinate between the Corporate Marketing Team, commercial team, bottlers, agencies, and partners to ensure program alignment, resource availability, and lead the Annual Business Plan using insights from category, consumer, shopper, and retailer data. Identify opportunities, translate brand strategies into actionable marketing and sales plans for each region and channel, with proper budget management.
  • Manage Talent & Sponsorships, Cultural Integration & Relationship Building: Embed the brand within local sports, gaming, music, and lifestyle scenes by developing relationships with influencers and opinion leaders to drive relevance and advocacy. Oversee athlete, ambassador, gamer, event producer, and partner performance through contracts and integrated marketing plans to maximize media visibility.
  • Plan and execute events at all levels—from grassroots to large-scale brand activations—ensuring alignment with brand strategies and business plans.
  • Leverage global, national, and regional brand properties and events, capturing on-the-ground insights to develop innovative, locally relevant marketing ideas.
  • Lead branding and visual identity efforts, including in-store shopper activations, ensuring consistent use of branding and logos across all campaigns and events, aligned with global guidelines.
  • Manage College Program & Sampling initiatives, including the Ambassadors Team and large-scale sampling operations to increase trial, visibility, and engagement.
  • Coordinate consumer promotions, managing the entire process from planning to execution, including agency management, terms and conditions, prizes, fulfillment, and post-promotional analysis to optimize future campaigns.
  • Support digital and social media engagement through content creation, athlete collaborations, and promotions in partnership with the Digital team.

Position Requirements

  • Bachelor's Degree in Business Administration, Marketing, Communications, or related field.
  • 1-3 years of marketing experience within top-tier CPG companies, preferably beverages.
  • Over 10 years of proven leadership experience in cross-functional teams.
  • Advanced proficiency in Microsoft Office tools, especially Excel, PowerPoint, and SharePoint.
  • Solid consumer brand management experience, with expertise in shopper/channel marketing programs and public relations.

title: MÉDICO CIRURGIÃO VASCULAR - HOSPITAL MUNICIPAL PEDRO II
description:
MÉDICO CIRURGIÃO VASCULAR - HOSPITAL MUNICIPAL PEDRO II

Desde dezembro de 2015, a SPDM/PAIS é responsável, em parceria com a Secretaria Municipal de Saúde do Rio de Janeiro, pelo gerenciamento do Hospital Municipal Pedro II .

A infraestrutura do hospital conta com dez andares, distribuídos entre emergência, unidades de terapia intensiva (UTI) adulta, pediátrica e neonatal, maternidade, clínica médica, cirurgia geral, bucomaxilofacial, neurocirurgia, psiquiatria, pediatria e ortopedia. Exames de imagem (raio X, tomografia, ultrassonografia, eletrocardiografia, ecocardiografia) e laboratoriais também são realizados na unidade.

Devido à grande população de idosos na Zona Oeste, região atendida pelo hospital, há duas enfermarias destinadas ao atendimento desse público.

O Centro de Tratamento de Queimados é outro diferencial, dispondo de uma UTI exclusiva para prevenir infecções graves em pacientes com queimaduras.

Além disso, a unidade conta com a Coordenação de Emergência Regional (CER) Santa Cruz, com 39 leitos, que absorve demandas de menor complexidade, deixando o HMPII livre para casos de risco de morte, cirurgias urgentes e internações. Este CER possui atendimento especializado em Psiquiatria e Obstetrícia.

Responsabilidades:

  • Prestar atendimento nas enfermarias, centro cirúrgico e Unidade de Terapia Intensiva do Hospital Municipal Pedro II.

Requisitos:

  • Ensino superior completo em Medicina.
  • Residência Médica ou Título de Especialista na área.
  • Registro ativo no conselho de classe.
  • Experiência mínima de 6 (seis) meses comprovada na função.

O hospital está localizado em Santa Cruz - RJ. A carga horária varia entre 10h, 12h e 24h semanais, dependendo da vaga.

Profissionais de empresas parceiras, fornecedores ou prestadores de serviço, com vínculo de parentesco ou atuação em diferentes modalidades contratuais, devem consultar as normativas de RH vigentes junto ao setor de Recrutamento e Seleção.

A SPDM - Associação Paulista para o Desenvolvimento da Medicina é uma entidade civil sem fins lucrativos, reconhecida de utilidade pública federal, estadual e municipal, atuando em vários níveis na gestão de serviços e organizações de saúde, com foco na promoção da saúde e na prevenção de doenças, atendendo a todos sem discriminação.

A organização busca expandir suas ações na área social e educacional, consolidando-se como uma grande instituição filantrópica que busca sustentabilidade social, econômica e ambiental.

Suas quatro superintendências — Hospital São Paulo, instituições afiliadas, Programa de Atenção Integral à Saúde (PAIS) e Educação — são geridas por profissionais altamente capacitados, contribuindo para a melhoria contínua dos serviços do SUS, garantindo acesso universal e de qualidade à saúde, apoiada por equipes multiprofissionais qualificadas.

O PAIS , iniciado em 2001 em São Paulo, estende-se a outros municípios e estados, buscando melhorar indicadores de saúde e a qualidade de vida, pautado nos princípios de integralidade e equidade, com gestão estratégica e aprimoramento contínuo.

Inclusão

A SPDM promove oportunidades de trabalho para pessoas com deficiência, com planos de carreira e anúncios periódicos divulgados nos principais jornais das regiões onde atua.

Missão

Promover ações em saúde integradas à gestão pública, de forma ética, humanizada, com qualidade técnica e compromisso social e ambiental.

Visão

Ser referência em gestão de serviços em saúde, garantindo atendimento de qualidade em todos os níveis de assistência para a população dos municípios e estados parceiros.

Jr. Operations Team Leader

title: Property Broker - Commercial Insurance (Real Estate, Hospitality, & Leisure)
description:
Description

Provide knowledge, leadership, insight and direction for broking activities to ensure that clients’ expectations are regularly met. This role incorporates a wide level of expertise, but always assumes the broker is capable of handling accounts independently. The size and complexity of the account can vary. More experienced brokers may be responsible for training and supervising Associate Brokers. Responsible to ensure that relevant regulatory and technical standards are met. Helps drive the broking team to achieve agreed operational and financial goals and objectives.

Note that visa employment-based non-immigrant visa sponsorship and/or assistance is not offered for this specific job opportunity

The Role

  • Orchestrate new business placement, renewals and alterations of existing coverage.
  • Develop, review and deliver presentations to secure new, and build on existing, relationships.
  • Review and evaluate information and analytics to assess and evaluate client risks to support the placement of client risks in the market.
  • Research and evaluate all solutions (insurance and otherwise) to identify and develop optimum risk solutions for clients.
  • Provide coverage and program design advice and expertise to client; perform needs and gap analysis to make recommendations regarding program improvements.
  • Build strong partnerships with a broad range of organizations and stakeholders in the market in order to secure optimum terms and conditions for clients.
  • Contribute to thought leadership and continuous process improvement of the Broking function.
  • Work closely with associates to stay on top of changes in the marketplace.
  • Oversee design and preparation of draft proposals; negotiate and finalize of carrier quotes, terms and conditions and coverage confirmations to ensure contract certainty.
  • Bind carrier quotes and review binders and coverage confirmations.
  • Request / Attend and participate in regular client and underwriter meetings.
  • Conduct program peer reviews.
  • Provide coaching to brokers in training.

Qualifications

The Requirements
• 5-12 years industry experience (real estate, hospitality and leisure industry experience preferred but not required)
• Insurance broker’s P&C license required
• Strong group presentation skills (written and verbal); ability to drive complex/technical conversations
• Relationship management: customer focus, collaboration, interpersonal skills, and conflict management; demonstrates shared ownership of resolution of conflicts
• Negotiation skills: carrier and client negotiation skills; can secure concessions without damaging relationships
• Business acumen: demonstrates knowledge of industries and clients, carriers, and/or markets
• Project management: ability to effectively manage and oversee small projects
• Receptive to feedback; critical thinking and problem-solving skills; high adaptability
• Leadership skills: applies judgment in making decisions, directs and motivates others, takes lead in small groups, and promotes teamwork
This position will remain posted for a minimum of three business days from the date posted or until sufficient/appropriate candidate slate has been identified.

Compensation and Benefits
Base salary range and benefits information for this position are being included in accordance with requirements of various state/local pay transparency legislation. Please note that salaries may vary for different individuals in the same role based on several factors, including but not limited to location of the role, individual competencies, education/professional certifications, qualifications/experience, performance in the role and potential for revenue generation (Producer roles only).


Compensation
The base salary compensation range being offered for this role is $150,000 - $175,000 USD per year.

Company Benefits

WTW provides a competitive benefit package which includes the following (eligibility requirements apply):

  • Health and Welfare Benefits: Medical (including prescription coverage), Dental, Vision, Health Savings Account, Commuter Account, Health Care and Dependent Care Flexible Spending Accounts, Group Accident, Group Critical Illness, Life Insurance, AD&D, Group Legal, Identify Theft Protection, Wellbeing Program and Work/Life Resources (including Employee Assistance Program)
  • Leave Benefits: Paid Holidays, Annual Paid Time Off (includes state/local paid leave where required), Short-Term Disability, Long-Term Disability, Other Leaves (e.g., Bereavement, FMLA, ADA, Jury Duty, Military Leave, and Parental and Adoption Leave), Paid Time Off (only included for Washington roles)
  • Retirement Benefits: Qualified contributory pension plan (if eligible) and 401(k) plan with annual nonelective company contribution. Non-qualified retirement plans available to senior level colleagues who satisfy the plans’ eligibility requirements.

Pursuant to the San Francisco Fair Chance Ordinance and Los Angeles County Fair Chance Ordinance for Employers, we will consider for employment qualified applicants with arrest and conviction records.

At WTW, we trust you to know your work and the people, tools and environment you need to be successful. The majority of our colleagues work in a ”hybrid” style, with a mix of remote, in-person and in-office interactions dependent on the needs of the team, role and clients. Our flexibility is rooted in trust and “hybrid” is not a one-size-fits-all solution.

We understand flexibility is key to supporting an inclusive and diverse workforce and so we encourage requests for all types of flexible working as well as location-based arrangements. Please speak to your recruiter to discuss more.

Diferenciais

Nossa história começou em 2001, com um pequeno escritório de agentes autônomos de investimentos em Porto Alegre, e hoje somos um grande ecossistema de serviços financeiros, mídia e educação.

Chegamos até aqui com a dedicação de equipes talentosas que tiveram garra, determinação, resiliência e, acima de tudo, ambição de fazer o impossível.

  • Foco no cliente: Somos obstinados em superar as expectativas dos nossos clientes.

// Sobre a oportunidade

Esta rede é direcionada a pessoas plenas e sêniores que buscam atuar como Investor na XP Inc na região de São Paulo. Temos vagas previstas para serem abertas em 2025, com diversas senioridades na estrutura. Caso seu perfil faça sentido para alguma destas vagas , entraremos em contato, convidando para avançar no processo seletivo.

Como Investor do time de Estratégia XP , você ficará responsável por trabalhar o asset allocation dos clientes de forma sofisticada, garantindo o enquadramento dos portfólios, de acordo com o suitability de cada cliente.

O Investor ocupa a posição de referência técnica para o segmento e, além de garantir a qualidade na alocação dos clientes, atua como interface direta com as áreas de negócio da companhia, pensando estrategicamente quais ativos devem ser trabalhados e quais perfis de cliente têm maior propensão para determinada oferta. Geram insumos comerciais para todo o time, através de treinamentos, dados, materiais, etc.

Principais responsabilidades:

  • Atender os principais clientes da XP, em conjunto com o Banker do cliente;
  • Ser referência técnica sobre produtos, planejamento financeiro e asset allocation no segmento;
  • Identificar as melhores oportunidades de investimentos, garantindo assertividade comercial;
  • Construir e disseminar as melhores práticas de investimentos entre os assessores;
  • Realizar consultoria de investimentos para garantir excelência no atendimento e monitorar os indicadores de qualidade;
  • Atuar no nível tático e estratégico junto às áreas que impactam direta e indiretamente o cliente final;
  • Sólido conhecimento sobre produtos financeiros (RV, RF, Fundos, Previdência, entre outros);
  • Conhecimento sobre asset allocation, enquadramento, inteligência de base;
  • Conhecimentos de macroeconomia e sua conjuntura atual;

Jornada de trabalho com flexibilidade

O nosso modelo de trabalho varia de acordo com a função: presencial para frentes de negócio e híbrido para as demais equipes. É importante ressaltar que todos os colaboradores precisam morar na localidade da vaga (nossa sede está localizada na cidade de São Paulo e é onde temos o maior número de posições), já que temos atividades que exigem a presença física para promover a colaboração e os rituais da nossa cultura. Esses encontros são organizados de acordo com as orientações dos líderes e as particularidades de cada rotina, para que nossos colaboradores possam exercer suas jornadas de trabalho com liberdade e autonomia.

title: MÉDICO OFTALMOLOGISTA RETAGUARDA - CENTRO CARIOCA DO OLHO
description:
Job description

O CENTRO CARIOCA DO OLHO está localizado na região central da cidade, no Bairro de Benfica. Os serviços prestados abrangem toda a população carioca, residente da cidade. É uma unidade especializada com vistas à promoção da saúde e prevenção de doenças e acidentes, além de identificar possíveis alterações relacionadas ou não com a atividade laboral e acadêmica, bem como possibilita a prevenção e a identificação precoce de eventuais patologias e riscos em potencial para a saúde visual e qualidade de vida.

A unidade de saúde é preparada para o atendimento às mais diversas patologias do universo oftalmológico para a população da cidade do Rio de Janeiro, tais como:

  1. diagnóstico e tratamento dos distúrbios da motilidade ocular, visão binocular e anomalias associadas;
  2. realização de exames para correção refrativa e adaptação de lentes de contacto, bem como para análise da função visual;
  3. avaliação da condução nervosa do estímulo visual e das deficiências do campo visual;
  4. programação e utilização de terapêuticas específicas de recuperação e reeducação das perturbações da visão binocular e de subvisão;
  5. ações de sensibilização, programas de rastreio e prevenção no âmbito da promoção e educação para a saúde;
  6. realização de exames oftalmológicos diagnósticos, corretivos e periódicos com o objetivo, prioritariamente, a preservação da saúde, em função dos riscos existentes das patologias de base como hipertensão arterial sistêmica, diabetes mellitus, assim como oriundas do ambiente de trabalho e educação.

Coordenar a fim de garantir o cumprimento de normas, rotinas, regulamentações da Instituição e das atividades planejadas para assistência, participando, analisando e avaliando os processos e as interfaces com a equipe para promover uma assistência segura e de qualidade. Acompanhar, analisar e tratar os relatórios e atendimentos necessários para o cumprimento das metas, prazos e melhorias.

Main responsibilities

Realizar atividades na especialidade de oftalmologia, prevenir, diagnosticar e tratar das doenças e distúrbios dos olhos e visão, conforme diretrizes da Instituição, Ministério da Saúde e Secretaria Municipal de Saúde.

Requirements and skills

Ensino Superior Completo em Medicina

Residência Médica ou Título de Especialista em Oftalmologia

Registro Ativo no Conselho da Classe/ Experiência mínima de 06 (seis) meses comprovada como Médico Oftalmologista.

Especialista em Traumatologia ou Urgência e Emergência em Oftalmologia, com comprovante de Estagio (Fellowship) em Traumatologia ou Urgência e Emergência ou Carta de Serviço ou Especialista na Área.

RQE ativo

title: Senior Cloud Engineer (SRE)
description:
Digibee is an iPaaS that scales integration workflows while reducing cost and technical debt. Rather than require specialized integration experts, Digibee lets every developer quickly build, test, deploy, govern, and monitor integrations across on-premise and cloud environments using a simple but powerful low-code interface.

Founded in São Paulo, Brazil, in 2017 and headquartered in Weston, Florida, our team is widely distributed throughout the Americas. In May of 2023, Digibee closed a Series B funding round of $60 million that is intended to drive our expansion in the United States.

About the role

Digibee is looking to hire experienced and motivated Cloud Engineers with cloud computing and Kubernetes expertise. As a Cloud Engineer responsible for all the platform stack, you will modernize, maintain, and implement our Platform features.

On a typical day, you will…

  • Design, implement, and manage all the Kubernetes clusters of our SaaS Cloud Platform.
  • Collaborate with DevOps and software engineering teams to ensure seamless integration of applications with Kubernetes environments.
  • Troubleshoot and resolve complex issues related to Kubernetes Network and computer networks in general.
  • Develop automation scripts and tools for deploying and managing Kubernetes Network and traditional cloud infrastructure.
  • Provide technical guidance and mentorship to junior cloud engineers and DevOps team members.
  • Work with cross-functional teams to increase our platform solutions portfolio.

What you’ll need to bring…

  • Strong Information Security and Linux System administration fundamentals.
  • Hands-on experience with containerization technologies like ContainerD and Docker.
  • Experience in Computer Networks - Load Balancer, TCP, VPN, Routing, Virtual Networks, MPLS, Firewall.
  • Experience with Cloud Platforms like AWS and GCP.
  • Good grasp on DevOps.
  • Excellent problem-solving skills and the ability to troubleshoot complex technical issues.
  • Strong communication and collaboration skills to work effectively with cross-functional teams.

It's a plus if you have…

  • Relevant certifications in Kubernetes and cloud platforms, such as CKA, CKAD, AWS Certified DevOps Engineer, or Azure DevOps Engineer Expert
  • Experience with container orchestration solutions like Amazon EKS, Azure Kubernetes Service, or Google Kubernetes Engine
  • Familiarity with CI/CD pipelines and tools, such as GitLab CI, FluxCD

Our perks and benefits

  • We’re remote first, with a flexible working schedule
  • Health care and Odonto Plan
  • R$ 1.200,00/month on Caju card (for food and meal allowance, mobility, home office supplies, culture, health, and education)
  • Life insurance
  • Child care assistance
  • Gympass
  • MacBook setup to work
  • English course: we have a partnership for group classes for R$100 monthly
  • Equity Program (RSUs)

Our culture

We believe in a highly collaborative work environment in order to foster constant development and exchange between teams. We encourage learning, sharing knowledge, and using new technologies to create disruptive ideas - we want to create something great together!

At Digibee, we know it's our people who make the difference. We embrace and value diversity and are dedicated to encouraging a supportive and respectful culture in our community.

We are interested in every qualified candidate eligible to work remotely in the country where this job posting is located. However, we are not able to sponsor visas for this position.

title: Implementations Project Manager, Fund Admin
description:
Implementations Project Manager, Fund Admin

The Company You’ll Join

Carta connects founders, investors, and limited partners through world-class software, purpose-built for everyone in venture capital, private equity and private credit.

Carta’s fund administration platform supports nearly 7,000 funds and SPVs, representing $150B in assets under administration in venture capital and private equity. Trusted by more than 40,000 companies, Carta also helps private businesses in over 160 countries manage their cap tables, valuations, taxes, equity programs, compensation, and more.

Together, Carta is creating the end-to-end ERP platform for private markets. Traditional ERP solutions don’t work for Private Funds. Private capital markets need a comprehensive software solution to replace outdated spreadsheets and fragmented service providers. Carta’s software for the Office of the Fund CFO does just that - it’s a new category of software to make private markets look more like public markets - a connected ERP for private capital.

At Carta we create owners and make private markets liquid.

We live in a world where some people live on the equity stack and enjoy exponential wealth growth and preferential tax treatment; others live on the debt stack and may work their entire lives for a company and retire only with the cash they’ve managed to save from their paychecks. Our contribution to solving the wealth inequality problem is moving people from the debt stack (payroll) to the equity stack. By making it as easy to issue equity to employees as it is to put them on payroll, we can create more owners.

At Carta, we are helpful, transparent, fair, and kind. We are relentless executors, unconventional thinkers, and masters of our craft.

To learn more, here is what one of our investors wrote about leading our Series F.

The Problems You’ll Solve

As an Implementations Project Manager, you will focus efforts on supporting new Investor Services customers in their journey into Carta services. You will drive operational excellence within our fast-growing Investor Services business by coordinating, facilitating and managing on-boarding activities that are critical to achieving success for both our customers and Carta within a tight deadline.

  • Support new Fund Administration, Portfolio Insights, and Valuations' clients by on-boarding them onto Carta – i.e., implementation of client’s limited partners list, investments, capitalization table and securities
  • Extract relevant information from operating agreements and subscription documents to upload limited partners to Carta
  • Analyze data thoroughly and precisely to maintain data integrity throughout the on-boarding process
  • Effectively liaise between sales and Investor Services teams as the bridge post-sales through implementation
  • Coordinate and manage multiple/simultaneous implementation projects by continually communicating with and motivating clients
  • Continuously look for ways to improve the efficiency and effectiveness of the on-boarding process
  • Work closely with product and engineering to improve the on-boarding experience for customers

The Impact You’ll Have

You’ll play a critical role in the transformation of the financial services industry through partnering with our new clients and helping them implement our software. In this role you will be responsible for interacting with a fund’s back office (CFO, fund manager) to collect their historical data, provide advisory support, and ultimately deliver accurate data to both the client and internal stakeholders.

About You

From sale close, to implementation, and continued customer success, the ideal Implementations Project Manager will exhibit excellent communication skills, a high degree of problem-solving, velocity, embracing change and will constantly seek ways to better their process to provide customers with a world-class on-boarding experience.

  • Proven success in a project management capacity
  • Ability to interpret a story through unstructured data
  • Experience working with financial data and information
  • Great people skills – high degree of empathy and great communication skills
  • Experience working with clients
  • Experience in implementing and successfully managing small and large projects or initiatives with sustained, measurable success
  • Incredible organizational skills, high attention to detail, and an ability to complete competing priorities quickly and autonomously
  • Passionate, tactical, and direct, with an ambitious attitude and a proven history to go above and beyond baseline requirements
  • Interested in working with enterprise software

Carta’s compensation package includes a market competitive salary, equity for all full time roles, exceptional benefits, and, for applicable roles, commissions plans. Why are you being asked to complete this form?

We are a federal contractor or subcontractor. The law requires us to provide equal employment opportunity to qualified people with disabilities. How do you know if you have a disability?

A disability is a condition that substantially limits one or more of your “major life activities.” If you have or have ever had such a condition, you are a person with a disability. Disabilities include, but are not limited to:

  • Alcohol or other substance use disorder (not currently using drugs illegally)

  • Cancer (past or present)

title: FP&A Specialist | Credit
description:
Nubank was founded in 2013 to free people from a bureaucratic, slow, and inefficient financial system. Since then, the company has been redefining people's relationships with money across Latin America through innovative technology and outstanding customer service. With operations in Brazil, Mexico, and Colombia, Nubank is one of the world’s largest digital banking platforms and technology-leading companies.
Today, Nubank is a global company with offices in São Paulo (Brazil), Mexico City (Mexico), Bogotá (Colombia), Durham (United States), and Berlin (Germany). It was founded in 2013 in Sao Paulo by Colombian David Vélez, and cofounded by Brazilian Cristina Junqueira and American Edward Wible. For more information, visit .

About the role

The challenge of our Financial Planning & Analysis (FP&A) team is to help Nubank make better financial decisions. Our mission is to understand the company’s performance from a financial perspective by analyzing past results and creating projections for the future. Broadly speaking, our team is divided into FP&A Horizontals, FP&A Markets, FP&A Global Products, FP&A Efficiency, and Procurement.

Key Responsibilities:
• Analyzing, explaining, and forecasting the financial results of the Credit Card Business Unit;
• Improving FP&A processes to generate insights and clarity in income statements, always thinking in a scalable way with reliable data;
• Understanding and analyzing the impacts of product-related decisions on the results of the Business Unit (BU);
• Automating reports by connecting them with databases from different sources;
• Building, updating, and reviewing financial models and simulators;
• Creating and presenting executive materials with financial results to the Business Unit and Leadership team.

We are looking for someone who:

• Has experience in financial analysis (P&L, Balance Sheet), credit analysis, or related areas;
• Has strong analytical skills to manage and evaluate complex data;
• Possesses strong communication skills to proactively engage with different business partners and stakeholders (Product, Finance, Markets);
• Has advanced knowledge of Excel / Google Sheets;
• Is fluent in English;
• Programming knowledge (Scala, SQL, and Python) is a plus.

title: Analista de Riscos
description:
Sobre nós

O Grupo Swile é um grupo multinacional francês pioneiro em benefícios flexíveis no Brasil. A nossa missão é ajudar a oferecer um melhor ambiente de trabalho para os seus colaboradores através dos benefícios flexíveis Swile que entregamos por meio de uma tecnologia de ponta.

Temos no grupo uma Instituição de Pagamento recém autorizada a funcionar pelo Banco Central do Brasil, e estamos em busca de novos integrantes para nosso time de Compliance, Controles Internos e Riscos.

Sobre a posição

  1. Criar métricas de avaliação de risco, incluindo baixo, médio e alto, partindo do zero;
  2. Gestão contínua do capital (controle de segundo nível);
  3. Monitorar os ativos ponderados pelo risco (RWA) e o Capital Regulatório (PR) (controle de segundo nível);
  4. Submeter documentos de risco ao Bacen;
  5. Criar a Declaração de Apetite ao Risco (RAS);
  6. Identificar, medir, avaliar, monitorar, reportar, controlar e mitigar riscos de crédito, operacionais, de liquidez, sociais, ambientais e climáticos;
  7. Criar políticas para rotinas da área, partindo do zero;
  8. Avaliar a criação de novos produtos ou serviços, bem como alterações ou manutenção dos produtos existentes;
  9. Criar testes de estresse;
  10. Elaborar um relatório anual sobre Riscos, inclusive operacional, a ser divulgado a Diretoria, Auditoria Interna e Externa;
  11. Elaborar o relatório do Pilar 3, incluindo a publicação no site;
  12. Criar o plano de continuidade de negócios com a equipe de Tecnologia e Produtos.

Requisitos

  1. Formação superior em Administração, Direito, Ciências Contábeis, Economia ou áreas correlatas;
  2. Inglês avançado;
  3. Experiência prévia de, no mínimo, 6 anos na área de Riscos, necessariamente em empresas reguladas pelo Banco Central do Brasil;
  4. Conhecimento das normas e regulamentações sobre Riscos do Banco Central do Brasil;

O que esperamos de você

  1. Capacidade de análise crítica, organização e atenção aos detalhes;
  2. Habilidade para trabalhar de forma colaborativa com diferentes áreas da empresa e com órgãos reguladores;
  3. Boa comunicação e habilidade para elaboração de relatórios e apresentações;
  4. Proatividade na identificação e solução de problemas relacionados aos Riscos identificados;
  5. Capacidade de adaptar-se rapidamente a mudanças regulatórias e operacionais;
  6. Engajamento para criar e fortalecer de Riscos numa Instituição de Pagamento que acaba de ser criada;
  7. Conexão com o propósito da Swile - ao se aplicar, entenda mais sobre nosso propósito e se ele conversa com o seu.

Sobre nossos valores

  1. We are team players: nós nos importamos com nossos colegas e navegamos bem entre áreas;
  2. We are doers: temos ano nível de autonomia e entregamos resultados tangíveis;
  3. We move fast: identificamos corretamente as prioridades e assumimos a iniciativa;
  4. We are ambassadors: entendemos sobre o mercado, o produto e estamos alinhados em torno da mesma visão;
  5. We stay hungry: somos resilientes e gostamos de aprender e compartilhar conhecimento;
  6. We cherish our values: abrimos mão do ego e aceitamos feedbacks como um presente.

O que oferecemos

  1. Pacote de benefícios flexíveis super atraentes para você usar como quiser (flexfood, mobilidade, cultura, educação, etc) dentro do cartão Swile;
  2. Remuneração variável;
  3. ️Plano de Saúde, Odontológico e Seguro de Vida;
  4. TotalPass (acesso às melhores academias e estúdios);
  5. Saúde emocional (sessões de terapia gratuitas com um de nossos parceiros);
  6. Swile Shop (desconto em mais de 1.100 lojas e restaurantes);
  7. ️Aulas de inglês ou francês;
  8. Auxílio farmácia;
  9. Day off de aniversário;
  10. Auxílio Home-office;
  11. Auxílio Creche.

Nós abraçamos e incentivamos a diversidade e inclusão no nosso time, então, sinta-se livre para ser quem você é junto à nós.

We call ourselves ebankers, we are global thinkers, we value diversity, we foster creativity and we work hard to connect businesses and people worldwide through payments. Let's make history together?

Your deep analytical skills will guide the continuous refinement and enhancement of our platform, ensuring it operates at peak performance and maintains operational excellence. Collaborating closely with cross-functional teams, you'll leverage your expertise to drive continuous improvement and optimization of our platform's performance metrics.

Besides conquering the world, your activities will be:

  • Performance Analysis: Utilize advanced analytics to scrutinize platform performance data. Identify trends, anomalies, and areas for improvement that will drive strategic decisions to enhance system efficiency and reliability.

Bewerbung und Position

Position: Erzieher/Erzieherin // Kindheitspädagoge/ Kindheitspädagogin

Tätigkeitsbeginn: ab 02/2026

Anstellungsdauer: 2 Jahre Vertrag, dann unbefristet

Aufgabenprofil

Das Colégio Visconde de Porto Seguro ist eine deutsche Auslandsschule, deren Abschlüsse von der KMK in Deutschland anerkannt werden. Die Schule wird von der Bundesrepublik Deutschland als Begegnungsschule gefördert und ist von der Ständigen Konferenz der Kultusminister (KMK) zur Abhaltung von Prüfungen der allgemeinen deutschen Hochschulreife (Abitur) ermächtigt. Mit zwei aufeinander abgestimmten Bildungsplänen sind sowohl deutsche als auch brasilianische Abschlüsse anerkannt und möglich.

Unsere motivierten Schülerinnen und Schüler lernen bereits im Kindergarten in zwei Kulturkreisen, was ihnen erweiterte Kenntnisse über Werte, Normen, Geschichte und Mentalität eines anderen Landes vermittelt.

Diese Stelle ist in Vollzeit ausgeschrieben. Neben der pädagogischen Tätigkeit wird die Mitarbeit in schulischen Gremien sowie Engagement bei außerunterrichtlichen Veranstaltungen erwartet.

Aufgaben

  • Arbeit in den Kindergartengruppen in deutscher Sprache (Deutsch ist Muttersprache!)
  • Teilnahme am Schulleben
  • aktive Beteiligung am Entwicklungsprozess des Kindergartens
  • Mitarbeit in der Unterrichts- und Schulentwicklung

Anforderungen

Gesucht werden engagierte Erzieher/Erzieherinnen oder Kindheitspädagogen/Kindheitspädagoginnen, die Freude am Umgang mit Kindern im Alter von 2 bis 5 Jahren haben und über Sozialkompetenz, selbstständige Arbeitsweise sowie freundliches Auftreten verfügen. Wichtige Eigenschaften sind Flexibilität, Aufgeschlossenheit, Motivation, Teamfähigkeit und Interesse am kulturellen Umfeld (Brasilien/Südamerika). Kenntnisse in Portugiesisch sind kein Muss, werden aber während des Arbeitsverhältnisses gefördert.

  • Ausbildung als ErzieherIn / KindheitspädagogIn
  • Berufserfahrung wünschenswert
  • hohe Einsatzbereitschaft, Neugier, Arbeitsfreude
  • Teamfähigkeit, Flexibilität, Belastbarkeit

Unser Angebot

Ein interessantes Arbeitsumfeld in einem motivierten Team. Die Vergütung richtet sich nach der Gehaltsrichtlinie der Schule und liegt über dem Landesdurchschnitt. Zusätzlich gibt es Leistungen wie Krankenversicherung, Lebensversicherung, Mietzuschuss sowie Umzugs- und Flugkostenpauschalen bei Zuzug aus dem Ausland.

Bewerbung

Bitte senden Sie Ihre vollständigen Unterlagen (Anschreiben, Lebenslauf, Abschlüsse, Fortbildungsnachweise) per E-Mail im PDF-Format an: (Kontaktangabe). Idealerweise in einer Gesamtdatei.

Der Schulleiter, Thomas Duque Mand, freut sich auf Ihre Bewerbung.

Advogado Sênior (EUDR)

Localização: Sao Paulo, São Paulo, BR,

Distribuída em mais de 40 países, líder mundial em processamento de oleaginosas e uma das maiores produtoras e fornecedoras de óleos, gorduras e proteínas vegetais há mais de dois séculos, a Bunge trabalha com o propósito de conectar agricultores a consumidores para fornecer alimentos, ingredientes e combustíveis essenciais para o mundo. Há 117 anos no Brasil, contamos com mais de 100 unidades e somos uma das principais empresas de agronegócio e alimentos, líder em originação de grãos e em processamento de soja e trigo. Em todas as nossas cadeias de valor promovemos nossos negócios de maneira sustentável ao mesmo tempo que apoiamos o bem-estar social e econômico das comunidades onde atuamos. Valorizamos a diversidade de nossos times e buscamos talentos criativos com espírito de equipe e vontade de fazer a diferença. Em tudo o que fazemos, colocamos em prática nossos valores:

  • Atuar como um só time, promovendo a inclusão, a colaboração e o respeito;
  • Buscar a excelência, sendo ágeis, inovadores e eficientes;
  • Fazer o que é certo, agindo de forma segura, ética e sustentável.

Na Bunge, valorizamos a diversidade em todas as suas formas e trabalhamos em prol de uma cultura inclusiva e de pertencimento, com respeito e equidade. Aqui, todas as pessoas são bem-vindas como são!

Nossa empresa possui uma sólida trajetória e estamos construindo um futuro repleto de oportunidades! Faça parte de nosso time e venha trilhar sua jornada profissional com a gente.

Missão do Cargo

Como advogado(a) nesta posição, você terá um papel fundamental na condução de assuntos relacionados ao EUDR (Regulamento da União Europeia sobre Produtos Livres de Desmatamento) e outras questões socioambientais. Você fornecerá suporte jurídico especializado e estratégico para garantir a conformidade com o EUDR, com foco na devida diligência em relação à origem dos produtos, à verificação do cumprimento da legislação aplicável nos países produtores (incluindo direitos humanos, direitos dos povos indígenas e comunidades locais) e à mitigação de riscos. Seu background generalista em áreas como Direito Tributário, Trabalhista e Compliance será um diferencial para uma atuação integrada e completa.

Atividades e Responsabilidades

  • Consultoria jurídica especializada para a área de direitos humanos e sustentabilidade em conformidade com o EUDR (Regulamento da União Europeia sobre Produtos Livres de Desmatamento), bem como nas demais áreas de legalidade exigidos pelo EUDR, como trabalhista, tributário, compliance, entre outras, baseada nos procedimentos e políticas internas da companhia.
  • Elaboração de pareceres e memorandos jurídicos com a avaliação de risco, com base na documentação analisada para evidenciar a devida diligência por parte da empresa.
  • Análise de processos administrativos e judiciais,considerando os aspectos relacionados à conformidade com a EUDR.
  • Análise de documentos processuais, incluindo processo de licenciamento, licenças ambientais, estudos de impacto ambiental, autorizações de supressão vegetal, TAC, plano de manejo, etc.,verificando sua conformidade com os requisitos do EUDR.
  • Acompanhar e controlar o fluxo dos processos desenvolvidos por advogados externos,garantindo a conformidade com a estratégia da empresa em relação ao EUDR.
